extracted.intended_audience: auditors of institutions of higher education and nonprofit organizations performing single audits under OMB Circular A-133; federal grant auditors and audit supervisors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and compliance-checklist supplement to OMB Circular A-133 to help auditors perform single audits of higher education institutions and non-profits by identifying applicable compliance requirements, program objectives, audit objectives, and suggested audit procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background, Purpose, and Applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the supplement's background, purpose, and the circumstances in which it applies to audits under the 1996 Amendments to the Single Audit Act and the final revision of OMB Circular A-133.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets scope for auditors on when and how the supplement is to be used; describes that it is based on the Single Audit Act Amendments of 1996 and the revised Circular A-133; no specific procedures but frames applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Matrix of Compliance Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides a matrix that maps compliance requirements to federal programs to help auditors identify which types of compliance requirements apply to each program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to avoid time-consuming research by quickly determining applicable compliance requirement categories for programs; serves as a cross-reference tool between programs and compliance areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance Requirements (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifies the compliance requirements that the Federal government expects auditors to consider as part of a single audit under the 1996 Amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The supplement lists and describes the categories of compliance requirements relevant to audits so auditors know what to test; intended to standardize which compliance areas are reviewed across programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency Program Requirements (Part 4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists specific requirements for many financial assistance programs of the U.S. Department of Education, providing program‑level compliance information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes program-specific compliance language and requirements (examples noted include Title I and TRIO programs); auditors should use these program entries when auditing recipients of these specific Department of Education programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clusters of Programs (Part 5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides guidance for auditing clusters of programs and identifies cluster-specific compliance considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Department of Education clusters and guidance for federal student loan program clusters such as Perkins, Pell, and Direct Loan programs; indicates how to treat grouped programs for single-audit purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit Objectives and Suggested Audit Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies audit objectives and suggests audit procedures for determining compliance with the identified requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives auditors suggested tests and procedures tied to each compliance requirement and program objective to determine whether recipients complied; intended as a practical 'how to' for audit fieldwork rather than prescriptive mandatory steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Control
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides guidance on internal control considerations relevant to audits of federal financial assistance programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes internal control concepts auditors should evaluate in connection with compliance testing and how internal control influences the nature, timing, and extent of audit procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance for Auditing Programs Not Included in This Compliance Supplement
rubrics_metrics.description: Offers procedures and considerations for auditing federal programs that are not specifically covered in the supplement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps auditors design appropriate audit steps for programs absent from the supplement, ensuring coverage of compliance requirements even when program-specific guidance is unavailable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement of Agency Audit Guides
rubrics_metrics.description: States that, for single audits, this supplement replaces agency audit guides and other audit requirement documents for individual federal programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auditors performing single audits should rely on this supplement rather than older or separate agency guides when performing single-audit testing and documenting compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuance of a Compliance Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides for the issuance of a compliance statement to assist auditors in performing the required audits under Circular A-133.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The supplement supplies standardized compliance statements and related explanatory material to guide auditors in documenting compliance conclusions for federal programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Objectives and Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets out the federal program's objectives and the program procedures that are relevant to auditors when planning and performing audit tests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auditors should use the stated program objectives to frame audit objectives and ensure that audit procedures are aligned with what the federal program is intended to achieve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendices Providing Additional Detail and Reference Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains multiple appendices that provide supplementary details, background information, and internal reference materials to support audit work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendices can include definitions, examples, and reference tables that auditors may use for clarification and to support the selection and execution of audit procedures.
